sections.h2: What Does an ERPNext Implementation Include?

paragraphs.text: An ERPNext implementation turns the open-source ERPNext software into a working system for your business. It covers requirement mapping, module setup, master data, opening balances, user roles, training and go-live support. A typical small-business project takes 6–10 weeks to launch.

paragraphs.html: As an ERPNext implementation company Kochi firms can visit in person, we deliver end to end ERPNext implementation with one team from start to finish. Our ERPNext setup services cover five areas, as part of our wider ERPNext development company in Kochi work.

items.title: Requirement Mapping
items.text: We document how sales, purchasing, stock, accounts and HR work today, and agree on what the new system must do. The result is a written ERPNext implementation plan with scope, owners and dates.

items.title: Module Setup and Configuration
items.text: ERPNext module setup covers company settings, chart of accounts, tax templates, warehouses, price lists and document numbering. Our ERPNext configuration services match each setting to your real process instead of leaving defaults in place.

items.title: Data Import
items.html: Customers, suppliers, items and opening balances are imported and checked. For larger moves from Tally or legacy software, see ERPNext data migration.

items.title: User Roles and Permissions
items.text: Each person sees only what their job needs, with approval rules built in.

items.title: Go-Live and Hypercare
items.text: Our ERPNext go live support includes a launch-day checklist and 30 days of close help after the system goes live.

sections.h2: Is Your Business Ready for ERPNext?
sections.intro: ERPNext fits growing businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets or a single-purpose accounting tool. You are likely ready if:

items.text: Month-end closing takes more than a week
Stock in the system rarely matches the shelves
Sales, stores and accounts keep separate records
You plan to add a branch, a warehouse or a new company

outro.text: If two or more of these sound familiar, an ERPNext implementation company Kochi teams trust can usually fix them in the first phase.

sections.h2: Cloud or On-Premise: Where Should Your System Run?
sections.intro: The right choice depends on your IT team and data rules.

items.html: Cloud: An ERPNext cloud implementation on Frappe Cloud or AWS needs no server room, includes automatic backups and lets staff log in from any branch.
On-premise: An ERPNext on-premise implementation runs on your own server. It suits firms with strict data policies or an in-house IT team.

outro.html: Our ERPNext deployment services cover both options, from server setup to user access. A good ERPNext implementation company, Kochi or elsewhere, should explain these trade-offs before you sign. Hosting and upgrades after launch move to our ERPNext support team.

items.q: What does an implementation partner do?
items.a: A partner plans, configures and launches ERPNext for your business. That includes requirement mapping, module setup, data import, user training and go-live support.

items.q: How long does setup take for a small business?
items.a: Most small businesses with one company and core modules go live in 6–10 weeks. Mid-size businesses with branches take 10–16 weeks.

items.q: Can we run Tally and ERPNext side by side?
items.a: Yes. We recommend a short parallel run of two to four weeks, so your accounts team can compare figures before switching fully. After go-live, you can keep Tally read-only for historical records.
Yes. Training is part of every project. Each role gets hands-on sessions on its own daily tasks, plus written guides and a named contact for the first 30 days.
You get 30 days of close support, with daily check-ins in the first week. Then you can move to a monthly support plan.

items.q: What do you need from us during the project?
items.a: We need one internal project owner who can make decisions, about two hours a week from each department head during discovery, and clean master data for customers, suppliers and items.

items.q: Is there an ERPNext implementation partner near me in Kochi?
items.a: Yes. Teknoppy's office is in Vyttila, Ernakulam, and we meet clients across Kochi in person. We can also visit your office for the discovery stage.
